metadata.description: VFS365 monitoring: a storage account with the errors, statistics and devices tables, the dashboard on the account's static website, CORS for it, and the two SAS URLs (devices: add only; dashboard: read only). See README.md, Setting up monitoring.
3 to 24 lower-case letters and digits, unique in Azure.
Where the storage account is (the resource group's location by default).
Standard_LRS is plenty for monitoring rows.
Years the devices SAS (MonitoringUrl, add only) is valid. Renew it before then.
Days the dashboard link's read-only SAS is valid; 0: no link. The link is kept in the resource group's deployment history, where anyone with read access to the group can see it.
Put the dashboard on the account's static website (https://<account>.z<n>.web.core.windows.net/) and allow only that address in CORS. Uses a short-lived deployment script (Azure Container Instances).
Where the deployment script gets the dashboard page: the latest release by default.
More addresses that may read the tables from a browser, for example ["*"] to also open the dashboard from disk.
Leave as is: the SAS lifetimes start now.

variables.script:
set -e
python3 -c 'import sys, urllib.request; urllib.request.urlretrieve(sys.argv[1], "vfs365-monitoring.html")' "$SOURCE"
grep -q 'VFS365 monitoring' vfs365-monitoring.html
az storage blob service-properties update --account-name "$ACCOUNT" --sas-token "$SAS" --static-website --index-document vfs365-monitoring.html --404-document vfs365-monitoring.html --output none
az storage blob upload --account-name "$ACCOUNT" --sas-token "$SAS" --container-name '$web' --name vfs365-monitoring.html --file vfs365-monitoring.html --content-type 'text/html; charset=utf-8' --content-cache-control 'no-cache' --overwrite --output none

cors.corsRules: [if(and(not(parameters('hostDashboard')), empty(parameters('extraCorsOrigins'))), createArray(), createArray(createObject('allowedOrigins', union(if(parameters('hostDashboard'), createArray(if(endsWith(reference(variables('storageId'), '2023-05-01').primaryEndpoints.web, '/'), take(reference(variables('storageId'), '2023-05-01').primaryEndpoints.web, sub(length(reference(variables('storageId'), '2023-05-01').primaryEndpoints.web), 1)), reference(variables('storageId'), '2023-05-01').primaryEndpoints.web)), createArray()), parameters('extraCorsOrigins')), 'allowedMethods', createArray('GET', 'OPTIONS'), 'allowedHeaders', createArray('*'), 'exposedHeaders', createArray('*'), 'maxAgeInSeconds', 3600)))]

metadata.description: The MonitoringUrl policy value for every device (add only).
The dashboard, connected with a read-only SAS. Keep it private.
The read-only SAS URL to paste into the dashboard (read only). Keep it private.
